# The beach: sand 18 x 6.7 m (renderer z -3.2 .. 3.5), its front face, and the sea 18 x 13 m
# (renderer z -16 .. -3) just under the sand's height, unlit: a sunset sea keeps its painted colours.
# Generated by make_env.py.
new
material new Sand --base-color 1 1 1 --no-slot
material new SandSide --base-color 0.5608 0.3412 0.3961 --no-slot
material new Sea --base-color 1 1 1 --emission 1 1 1 --no-slot
add mesh cube --name Sand --size 1 --location 0 -0.15 -0.4
scale 18 6.7 0.8
apply --scale
material assign SandSide
active Sand
mode edit
select face where "normal.z < -0.9 || normal.x > 0.9 || normal.x < -0.9 || normal.y > 0.9"
delete only-faces
select face where "normal.z > 0.9"
material assign Sand
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Sand base-color textures/sand.png
add mesh plane --name Sea --size 1 --location 0 9.5 -0.1
scale 18 13 1
apply --scale
material assign Sea
active Sea
mode edit
select all
uv project-from-view top --scale-to-bounds
mode object
material texture Sea base-color textures/sea.png
select all
shade flat
export beach.glb
